description: Knox stalled plaud-ingest at step-03 (awaiting-input) asking David to identify Speaker 3 on the 09-24 GEHC architecture recording and Speaker 1 on the 09-25 4th Friday Executive Meeting, when both recordings' timestamps could be cross-referenced against calendar attendees to resolve the speakers. The plaud-speaker-id skill's documented method is exactly this: cross-reference recording timestamps against calendar attendees. David's correction: 'Why are you asking me about speaker ID when it's in the calendar invite?' Master also relayed the question to David uncritically instead of redirecting Knox to the calendar first.
correction: Before escalating an unresolved speaker to David, cross-reference the recording's date/time window against calendar event attendees (data/calendar-unified.json or M365 outlook_calendar_search). Only ask David when the calendar cross-reference genuinely fails or produces ambiguity the data cannot resolve.
systemic_fix: Reinforce in plaud-speaker-id / plaud-ingest step-03: calendar-attendee cross-reference is a mandatory step before any 'awaiting-input' escalation to the controller; an escalation payload must state what the calendar lookup returned and why it was insufficient. Master should challenge speaker-ID escalations that lack evidence of a calendar lookup. APPLIED 2026-10-16 (Stage 3 K4 remediation): the requirement is now machine-checkable and enforced. step-03 (workflows/plaud-ingest/steps/step-03-identify-speakers.md) and skills/plaud-speaker-id/SKILL.md require the run to write accumulated-context.escalation-evidence (naming the calendar lookup + why it was insufficient) and unresolved_speakers before escalating, and to never leave a generic 'Speaker N' as a speaker-mappings value. The check type 'yaml_field_pattern' those checks declared but which was unimplemented (so plaud-sp-004/005 silently skipped as 'unknown check type') is now implemented in systems/eval-harness/assertion_checks.py and mirrored in .claude/hooks/eval-turn-stop.py; plaud-ingest.json gains plaud-k4-escalation-evidence and plaud-k4-no-generic-speaker-labels, and plaud-speaker-id.json's plaud-sp-004/005 were repointed to the state.yaml evidence fields. The recorded defect (escalating to David without cross-referencing the calendar) now fails those assertions.
